steps.label: Authenticate to I9 Complete
steps.note: Kernel-auto-prepended step from `systems: [{ id: 'i9', login: loginToI9 }]`. Two-step email+password login; no Duo MFA. Fails loud via classifyI9LoginResult on bad credentials. Training-notification dismiss is graceful (no-op if absent).

operations.label: Navigate to I9 Complete login page
Fill email / username
operations.note: Derived from I9_USER_ID; appends @ucsd.edu if no @ present

operations.label: Race: wait for wwwe.i9complete.com redirect vs login error visible
Assert login succeeded via classifyI9LoginResult
operations.summary: Throws with clear .env credential hint if loginError is visible, URL is /Account/Login, or redirect never arrived

operations.label: Click Dismiss training notification (optional)
operations.note: Graceful — entire notification branch is in a try/catch; no-op if popup absent

operations.label: Click Yes to confirm training notification dismiss
operations.note: Only executed when training notification was present

operations.label: Wait for dashboard URL after notification dismiss

steps.label: Search I9 and Look Up Section 2 Signer
steps.note: Delegates to lookupSection2Signer (src/systems/i9/signer.ts), which calls searchI9Employee (src/systems/i9/search.ts). Branches on result count, access-restricted alert, Next Action eligibility, and historical-record URL redirect. Outputs signerName, i9Status, and optionally profileId via ctx.updateData.

operations.label: Open Search Options dialog
operations.summary: Via clickWithKendoRecovery — snapshots visible Kendo windows, closes stale modals, retries once

operations.label: Wait for search dialog to become visible
Fill SSN field for disambiguation (optional)
operations.note: Only filled when ssn is present in input. Format: XXX-XX-XXXX with dashes (differs from create which uses no dashes).

operations.label: Wait 1s for results grid to populate
Parse search results grid rows
operations.summary: Grid columns: Last Name, First Name, Employer, Worksite, Profile ID, I-9 ID, Next Action, Start Date, Created On. Skips rows with <5 cells.

operations.label: Branch: zero results — check access-restricted vs genuine not-found
operations.summary: If resultRows.count() === 0: inspect search.accessRestrictedAlert. count > 0 → return status:unable-to-access; else → return status:not-found

operations.label: Detect access-restricted alert on zero results
operations.summary: count() > 0 means record exists but operator's account lacks scope (unable-to-access); 0 means genuine not-found

operations.label: Pick first eligible signer lookup row from results
operations.summary: pickI9SignerSearchResult: finds first result where nextAction is non-empty and does NOT match /^complete\s+section\s+[12]$/i. No eligible row → return status:unsigned.

operations.label: Navigate directly to I-9 summary page
operations.summary: Deterministic URL built from search hit IDs; waitUntil:domcontentloaded then networkidle(5s). Paper imports redirect to /form-I9-historical/…

operations.label: Wait for network idle after summary navigation
Detect historical (paper) I-9 redirect
operations.summary: page.url().includes('/form-I9-historical/') → return status:historical (paper import; no electronic Section 2 audit row exists)

operations.label: Wait for summary view heading
operations.summary: waitForSummaryView: summary.heading OR getByText('Electronic I-9 Audit Trail') OR getByText('Audit History') — .first().waitFor(visible, 10s)

operations.label: Wait for audit-trail table header row
operations.summary: .first().waitFor(visible, 10s) — heading renders before audit table; must wait on header before counting signedSection2Row to prevent race (early count 0 mis-classifies signed as unsigned)

operations.label: Scrape 'Signed Section 2' audit row to extract signer name
operations.summary: row.count() === 0 → status:unsigned. row.getByRole('cell').allTextContents() → last cell = Created By (signer). Audit columns: [Section, Date, Event, Created By]. Empty last cell → status:error.

operations.label: Emit lookup result via ctx.updateData and take screenshot
operations.summary: ctx.updateData({ signerName: result.signerName ?? '', i9Status: result.status, profileId? }); ctx.screenshot({ kind: 'form', label: 'i9-lookup-summary', systems: ['i9'] })

notes: Delegated-only workflow — no dashboard start surface. Invoked exclusively via ctx.delegateTo / ctx.delegateToAll from parent workflows (e.g. oath-signature, OCR fan-outs).
Runtime policy: alwaysBatchDelegatedMembers=true keeps even a lone delegated lookup as a one-member batch surface; memberRow.titleSource='person'.
Auth is eager (kernel-launched at session start), not deferred — I9 Complete login is fast enough and has no Duo MFA.
I9 search is name-based (lastName + firstName ± ssn). Do NOT change to EID — I9 Complete's internal employeeId is distinct from UCPath's emplId.
Summary navigation is deterministic (goto /form-I9/summary/{profileId}/{i9Id}) — the old click-through (last-name link → record-expand → Summary-tab) was fragile; replaced 2026-06-06.
Output i9Status values: 'signed' | 'unsigned' | 'historical' | 'not-found' | 'unable-to-access' | 'error'. 'unable-to-access' means record exists but operator's account lacks scope.
No fan-out, no delegation gate, no preview. Single person in → single row out.
